同じOT初期セル平均と同じdt列でCT/GLMを計算し、別に実行したAthena++の格子・時間感度を分離した参照と比較します。 入力・検証手順の履歴 · 初回の入力 前提・単位・境界 標準周期OT、γ=5/3、ρ=25/(36π)、p=5/(12π)、v=(−sin2πy,sin2πx)、B=(−sin2πy,sin4πx)/√(4π)、t=.05。16²/32²/64²の両法に192刻みを共用します。旧配布版を改変しない追加検証です。 編集上の補足 共通の数値流束族・速度上限・時間刻み・物理減衰率を固定しますが、CTの面磁場とGLMのセル磁場、法線磁場の扱いは異なります。離散化全体の比較であり、差のすべてを発散処理だけの効果とはしません。CT固有の面発散と共通のセル中心発散は別の演算子として報告します。 採用した計算法 主計算は固定α=ch=3のRusanovと前進Euler、GLMκ=2は格子に依存しません。独立C++ Athena++はHLLD・PLM・RK2・upwind CTです。同じ連続初期値を用いますが、Athenaのface/primitive離散化は主計算と完全同一ではありません。 Fi+1/2=12[F(UL)+F(UR)−α(UR−UL)],α=3Fi+1/2​=21​[F(UL​)+F(UR​)−α(UR​−UL​)],α=3 密度・磁場L1誤差、格子改善、正値性、保存量とdiv/ψを測定。Athena256²/512²はともにCFL=.15、512²のCFL=.3/.15差で参照の時間感度を確認し、両増分が主計算誤差の.1以下か判定します。主計算の固定16²での時間収束を別実行DOP853へ照合し、最細格子の刻み倍増差も確認します。 確認の限界と失敗条件 短時間の滑らかなOTで、衝撃波後・3D・一般のcleaning性能の認証ではありません。独立Athena参照も有限格子数値解で、増分は誤差上界ではありません。旧128²/CFL.3は履歴だけで256²/CFL.15との組を純粋な格子次数に使いません。定数LLFによるGLMのdiv=ψ=0保存をcleaning成功とは呼びません。native面divと共通中心divを区別し、中心演算子のcheckerboard盲点も残します。 Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Orszag–Tang: matched CT/GLM and converged independent references Run CT/GLM with the same OT initial cell averages and dt sequence, comparing with separately executed Athena++ references whose mesh/time sensitivities are separated. Input and validation protocol history · Initial input Assumptions, units and boundaries Standard periodic OT: gamma5/3, rho25/(36pi), p5/(12pi), v=(−sin2piy,sin2pix), B=(−sin2piy,sin4pix)/sqrt(4pi), t=.05. Both methods share192 steps on16²/32²/64². This supplements the previous immutable release. Editorial clarification Match the flux family, signal bound, time steps and physical damping, while retaining intrinsic differences in face versus cell magnetic fields and normal-field treatment. Compare the whole discretizations; do not attribute every difference solely to divergence control. Report native CT face divergence separately from a common cell-centered divergence. Adopted numerical method Primary runs use fixed alpha=ch=3 Rusanov/forward Euler and grid-independent GLM kappa2. Independent C++ Athena++ uses HLLD/PLM/RK2/upwind CT. Continuous initial fields agree; Athena’s face/primitive discretization is not identical. Fi+1/2=12[F(UL)+F(UR)−α(UR−UL)],α=3Fi+1/2​=21​[F(UL​)+F(UR​)−α(UR​−UL​)],α=3 (Bx)t+∂xψ+∂y(vyBx−vxBy)=0,ψt+ch2∇⋅B=−κψ(Bx​)t​+∂x​ψ+∂y​(vy​Bx​−vx​By​)=0,ψt​+ch2​∇⋅B=−κψ Dhface curl⁡hE=0,Dhcell≠DhfaceDhface​curlh​E=0,Dhcell​=Dhface​ References and measured quantities Measure density/magnetic L1 error, mesh improvement, positivity, conservation and div/psi. Athena256²/512² both useCFL.15; fixed512² CFL.3/.15 checks reference time sensitivity, with increments compared against.1 of primary error. At fixed16², compare primary time refinement with separately executed DOP853 and check finest-grid step doubling. Verification limits and failures Short smooth OT, not certification of post-shock,3D or general cleaning behavior. Athena is a finite-grid numerical reference; increments are not error bounds. Historical128²/CFL.3 is not paired with256²/CFL.15 to infer a pure spatial order. Constant-LLF preservation of GLM div=psi=0 is not evidence of active cleaning. Native face and common centered divergences differ; centered checkerboard blind spots remain. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
